answer: Signed satellite positioning proves each identity occupies a distinct place on Earth. At signup the device records GNSS readings, signed in its secure element, and an umber beacon challenge must be answered in minutes, tying the fix to this epoch. Each fake identity needs another device carried to another spot on the horizon, so cost grows with every sock puppet, and the voyage between fixes cannot be faked by replay. Audits sample identities each epoch and demand a new signed fix; failures slash the bond. Limits: spoofed signals and indoor users can slip, so pair it with liveness checks.
